title: Verify your identity
sub: Confirm who you are to unlock payouts, earn your verified badge and build trust with your fans.

needRows.title: A government ID
needRows.text: Passport, ID card or driving licence

needRows.title: A camera
needRows.text: To scan your ID and take a quick selfie

needRows.title: About 3 minutes
needRows.text: Most checks are approved within minutes

howRows.title: Scan your ID
howRows.text: Snap a clear photo of a government-issued document. Make sure all four corners are visible.

howRows.title: Take a selfie
howRows.text: A quick liveness check to confirm it is really you and matches your ID.

howRows.title: Get reviewed
howRows.text: We check everything securely. You will get a notification as soon as it is done.

whyRows: Verified badge on your public profile
Instant payouts straight to your account
More trust and reach with your fans
footer: Takes about 3 minutes · usually approved within minutes
align: Align your ID inside the frame
